name: Development
description: Combines the S2 hardware resource policy (sustained mixed workloads, no forced performance governor) with the S3 development-workstation software layer: a curated Ubuntu package set plus user-level tool detection/planning for Git/GitHub, Python (uv), Node (fnm/pnpm), Rust (rustup), Go, C/C++, Zed, and containers (Podman/Distrobox). No package is installed and no user config is written by this repository - see docs/development/architecture.md and docs/development/installation-plan.md for what 'implemented' means here.

rollback.notes: No Apply mechanism exists yet in S2/S3; serein hardware plan and serein dev plan are both read-only. See docs/hardware/architecture.md and docs/development/architecture.md for what a future Apply step would need.
